description: Example collection using the stac extension

stac:geometry.description: Footprint in EPSG:4326 as WKB, when the producer supplies one

stac:bbox.description: Bounds of geometry [west, south, east, north]; west > east crosses the antimeridian

stac:centroid.description: Center of the grid, or of the footprint without a grid, in EPSG:4326

stac:datetime.description: Acquisition time; null when only a range is known

stac:start_datetime.description: First time covered by the observation, inclusive

stac:end_datetime.description: Last time covered by the observation, inclusive

stac:proj_code.description: CRS of the grid as AUTHORITY:CODE, e.g. EPSG:32718

stac:proj_shape.description: Grid size in pixels as [height, width]

stac:proj_transform.description: Affine transform [a, b, c, d, e, f]: x = a*column + b*row + c, y = d*column + e*row + f
